## Notes

Free alpha; skeleton analyzed for internal forces and torques to charge energy costs; creatures eat only within head reach; rovers feed or kill by genetic distance to a target genome and can be programmed to deforest or fertilize; climate control devices make cold, hot, fertile, or dead ground; fences.
